title: Senior Accounts Executive
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Senior Accounts Executive to manage day-to-day accounting operations, financial documentation, GST compliance, taxation, vendor payments, bank reconciliation, and monthly financial reporting.

**Roles & Responsibilities: -**

* Manage day-to-day accounting and finance activities using Tally ERP/Tally Prime.
* Prepare and verify sales invoices, purchase invoices, debit notes and credit notes.
* Handle GST compliance, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, e-Invoice and e-Way Bill.
* Perform GST reconciliation between books, GSTR-1, GSTR-2B and purchase records.
* Manage accounts payable and receivable, vendor/customer reconciliation and payment follow-up.
* Prepare bank reconciliation statements (BRS) and monitor daily banking transactions.
* Maintain ledger scrutiny, journal entries, provisions and month-end closing.
* Coordinate with vendors and customers regarding invoices, payments, GST and account reconciliation.
* Verify PO, MRN/GRN and invoice details before processing payments.
* Assist in preparation of MIS reports, outstanding reports, ageing reports and financial statements.
* Coordinate with auditors and provide required documents and accounting data.
* Ensure proper documentation and compliance with company accounting policies.
* Handle TDS, GST and other statutory accounting requirements.
* Coordinate with internal departments such as Purchase, Sales, Stores, Logistics and IT for accounting-related issues.

**Required Skills & Qualification: -**

* Minimum 5 -6 years of relevant experience in accounts & finance department.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, GST, TDS, and taxation.
* Hands-on experience with **Tally ERP / Tally Prime** and MS Excel.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines independently.
* Must have completed their education in B.com/ M.com .

**Note** :- Candidates can apply this job opportunity only from the manufacturing background.

Pay: From ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
